title: Agent Braid declared-versus-observed receipt (draft, not adopted)
description: Result of one checkpoint check: the declaration compared with committed or quiesced Git state. Paths and hashes only. On a shared working tree (agent teams, sessions editing in place) Git cannot attribute a change to a unit, so this receipt attributes nothing to any unit there: every changed path is an unattributed writer with unknown effect, and a per-unit comparison is not made for it. A list longer than its bound is cut deterministically (sorted, first entries) and the cut is recorded in truncations with the total, so a busy shared tree yields a partial receipt, never a refusal and never a clean one. A per-unit not-observed outcome is a result of the observation contract and is never clean. A refusal (busy lock, unstable snapshot, unobservable or over-bound source, existing output path) is not representable here: it is an error under command-error.schema.json and produces no receipt.

property.const: Exact repository-relative path agreement between declared ownership and file-level Git effects at the named snapshot; not semantic commutation, hunk-level safety or order independence.

evidenceMethod.const: Declaration validation and expansion, and the bounded read-only Git adapter run in-process by the bundled CLI over committed or quiesced worktrees; the plugin MCP is not used.

domain.const: Committed or quiesced Git state of at most 32 units in one repository; file-level resources.

const: The declaration was written against the stated base.
The observed worktrees were committed or quiescent for both Git observations.
Writers that cannot be attributed to a unit are unknown, not violations; on a shared working tree no change is attributed to any unit.

observationContract.const: Added and modified files are write effects; deletions, renames, binaries, symlinks and submodules are unknown; reads are never observed; Bash in flight, MCP effects and uncommitted work of active writers are not observed; absent observations are not-observed and never mean clean.

executionContract.const: Read-only; no launch, message, resume, grant, edit, merge or write other than the explicit new output path; executionAuthorization is false.

observation.description: not-observed is never clean; the unit's coverage is partial.

notObservedReason.description: Only reasons that are outcomes of the observation contract. Busy, unstable, unobservable and over-bound are refusals (errors), not reasons.

unattributedWriters.description: Paths changed in a shared checkout that cannot be tied to a unit (orchestrator, human or shared-tree edits, agent teams on one tree). Unknown effect by default; never a unit's violation. A path covered by a declared exemption rule is listed under exemptedPaths instead.

exemptedPaths.description: Paths excluded from unattributedWriters by an explicit exemption rule declared in the declaration. The rule id is recorded; the exclusion is the orchestrator's declaration, not an observation that the write is safe.

truncations.description: Lists that were cut to their bound. Empty means nothing was cut. A receipt with an entry here is partial: it is never clean.
